modern: Do not act as if you were going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over you. While you live, while it is in your power, be good.
original: Do not act as if thou wert going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over thee. While thou livest, while it is in thy power, be good.
notification: Do not act as if you were going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over you. While you live, while it is in your power, be good.
notification_original: Do not act as if thou wert going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over thee. While thou livest, while it is in thy power, be good.

explained.summary: Don’t live as if you have ten thousand years. Death is always hanging over you. So while you’re alive and still can, be good. Marcus isn’t being morbid. He’s reminding himself not to put off becoming the person he means to be.
explained.today: Think of the apology you keep postponing, the friend you’ve meant to ring for months, or the habit you’ll fix “after this busy spell”. There may not be an after.
